long_biography.plain_text:
Syrmas built his career in the management of Greek healthcare institutions, working with the Onassis Cardiac Surgery Center, Metropolitan Hospital, Iaso and Hygeia as an executive or adviser. He moved into group leadership as Hellenic Healthcare Group's chief financial and operating officer, combining responsibility for finance with oversight of a growing hospital platform.

His governance work has extended across the group's network. Syrmas has held board seats at Hygeia, Metropolitan hospitals and Aretaeio Hospital in Cyprus, supporting strategy and administrative control. He has also spoken publicly about private healthcare's response to the pandemic and Greece's development as a medical-tourism destination.
